translation_notes: The site the stratifier flagged (sites[0].line == 4) is `from .namespaces import ANS`: ANS is dfriedenberger/generators' own project vocabulary object, genuinely ns_import_project -- rewritten `from generators_context import SparQLWrapper, ans:`, with ANS.hasKeyValuePair/.key/.value/.Dictionary becoming ans:hasKeyValuePair/:key/:value/:Dictionary (4 of the 7 namespace_term sites).

SAME split documented for the LexMalta/edmondchuc siblings of this stratum: RDF (`from rdflib import RDF`) is rdflib's own namespace, not a project module -- it cannot be given a __namespaces__ export, so RDF.type/RDF.Seq became `@prefix rdf: <...> .` + rdf:type/rdf:Seq instead of a prefix import (2 more of the 7 sites). classification minor-restructuring for the same reason as those siblings: two different namespace origins forced two different constructions in the same import block.

The 7th namespace_term site is process_seq's `URIRef(RDF["_{}".format(index)])`: a namespace subscript with a COMPUTED local part. Translated as `URIRef(rdf:{"_{}".format(index)})` -- terms.md's interpolated-local-part form (`ex:{name}`) -- keeping the original (redundant, since RDF[...] already returns a URIRef) outer URIRef(...) wrapper untouched, since removing it would be cleanup INSTRUCTIONS_403 forbids. Verified directly by transpiling: the interpolation's own `{}` from `"_{}".format(...)` (braces inside a string literal, inside the outer interpolation braces) does not confuse the island scanner -- emits `_ldpy_.pname(NS, ("_{}".format(index)))` correctly. This is the 1 term_constructor.

generators_context.py (shim) reconstructs ANS with a PLACEHOLDER base IRI, documented there: the real ontology file namespaces.py reads at import time (`models/assets-0.0.2.ttl`) is not part of the repository at any commit, any release, or any published sdist/wheel of `artifact-generator` (checked directly against the GitHub tree and PyPI) -- so there is no real IRI to be faithful to, only the real local names (the fragments passed to OntologyReader.get_*()). This is immaterial to correctness: no ANS.* IRI is ever returned by rdf2json.py (its output is plain JSON -- str/int/float/bool/dict/list), only used to walk the graph, so any consistent base works as long as both representations resolve through the SAME shim, verified by the driver.

oracle corrected from the mechanical draft's isomorphism to values: this region has zero .add()/.remove() -- it is pure graph reading (rdf_ops: namespace_term + term_constructor only, no triple_add/triple_remove) -- so the generic run_pair(entry=None) module-state comparison would have found no graph to compare and reported a hollow green. fixture.ttl + a custom driver (module-state's generic per-argument comparison does not special-case a SparQLWrapper the way it special-cases a bare Graph -- see driver.py) establish real equivalence: same JSON value out for the same graph in, including the zero-solutions case (ex:obj2) and a neighbourhood that must not match (ex:kv-orphan, ex:obj3).

No graph_read/trav_* island used for the .objects()/.value()/`in graph` calls, even though the region reads a graph: this region's only assigned stratum is ns_import_project (same discipline as the LexMalta sibling's own note) -- the point under test here is the import construction, and forcing m{ }/trav_* onto reads that were never in scope risks the cardinality/ordering pitfalls INSTRUCTIONS_403 §2 warns about for no measured benefit.
